name: is_perfect (perfect-graph test, Strong Perfect Graph Theorem)

benchmarks.note: even cycle C_n is bipartite, so is_perfect returns true via the bipartite fast path before the complement is ever built. Cost is dominated by is_simple + is_bipartite, both O(V+E); near-linear scaling (~9.5x per 10x n step plus the ~5x final step matches the BFS 2-colouring + simple-check passes over the ring)

odd cycle C_n has odd girth n>3 → not perfect, but the verdict only lands after the Weak-Perfect-Graph-Theorem probes materialise the DENSE complement (~n(n-1)/2 - n edges) and run is_bipartite + is_chordal (MCS) on it. Super-linear because the complement edge count grows quadratically with n; sizes kept modest for this reason. This faithfully mirrors upstream igraph_is_perfect's decision order
